title: HuluOPD: Unifying Heterogeneous Medical Specialists into One Lightweight Model with Unlabeled Prompts
abstract: arXiv:2611.32021v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Specialist medical vision-language models (VLMs) are strong within their specialties but hard to unify: their training data are often private, and independently developed specialists cannot be assumed to share an architecture. Deploying these large models separately is costly. We present HuluOPD, an on-policy distillation recipe that unifies heterogeneous specialists into one lightweight VLM using only unlabeled prompts, without requiring reference answers or the specialists' training data. The lightweight model answers each prompt, and the specialist of the prompt's modality supervises its response; a continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss makes this possible even when they differ in architecture and tokenizer. We apply HuluOPD to five specialists, for ultrasound, pathology, optical coherence tomography, fundus photography, and dental imaging. To distill and evaluate them, we build HuluOPDCorpus, 914k unlabeled prompts, and HuluOPD

translated_title: HuluOPD：利用无标注提示将异构医学专科模型统一为一个轻量级模型
translated_abstract: 专科医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）在其各自专科领域内表现出色，但难以统一：它们的训练数据通常是私有的，且独立开发的专科模型无法假定共享相同的架构。分别部署这些大型模型的成本很高。我们提出了HuluOPD，这是一种在线策略蒸馏方法，仅使用无标注提示就能将异构的专科模型统一为一个轻量级VLM，无需参考答案或专科模型的训练数据。轻量级模型对每个提示进行回答，并由该提示所属模态对应的专科模型监督其回答；一种与续写内容对齐的跨分词器损失（continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss）使得即使在两者架构和分词器不同的情况下也能实现这一点。我们将HuluOPD应用于五个专科模型，分别涵盖超声、病理、光学相干断层扫描（OCT）、眼底照相和牙科影像。为了进行蒸馏和评估，我们构建了包含91.4万条无标注提示的HuluOPDCorpus以及HuluOPD
tldr: HuluOPD提出一种在线策略蒸馏方法，仅用无标注提示和跨分词器监督损失，就能把架构各异的多个医学专科视觉-语言模型统一蒸馏为一个轻量级统一模型，无需参考答案或专科模型的原始训练数据。
